translations.literal: Chang was by nature timid and weak and could not govern his state; affairs were all entrusted to eunuchs, and again palace women wore caps and belts, held nominal offices, and handled external affairs, so that discipline was utterly ruined.
translations.idiomatic: Chang was by nature timid and weak and could not govern his state. Affairs were all entrusted to eunuchs, and again palace women wore caps and belts, held nominal offices, and handled external affairs, so that discipline was utterly ruined.

sentences.zh: 先是，廣州法性寺有菩提樹一株，高一百四十尺，大十圍，傳云蕭梁時西域僧真諦之所手植，蓋四百餘年矣，皇朝乾德五年夏，為大風所拔。

translations.literal: Earlier at the Faxi Temple in Guangzhou there was one bodhi tree, one hundred forty chi in height and ten arm-spans in girth; tradition said the Western Regions monk Zhendi of the Liang of Xiao had planted it by hand, already more than four hundred years; in the summer of the fifth year of Qiande of the dynasty it was uprooted by a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier at Guangzhou's Faxi Temple stood a bodhi tree one hundred forty chi tall and ten arm-spans around. Tradition held that the Western monk Zhendi had planted it in the Liang era, more than four hundred years before. In the summer of the fifth year of Qiande of our dynasty a great wind uprooted it.

sentences.zh: 是歲秋，鋹之寢室屢為雷震，識者知其必亡。

translations.literal: That autumn Chang's sleeping chamber was repeatedly struck by thunder; men of judgment knew he would surely perish.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn thunder repeatedly struck Chang's sleeping chamber. Men of judgment knew he would surely perish.

sentences.zh: 皇朝開寶三年夏，王師始議南征。

translations.literal: In the summer of the third year of Kaibao of the dynasty the imperial army first deliberated a southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the third year of Kaibao the imperial army first deliberated a southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 四年二月五日，王師壓廣州，鋹盡焚其府庫，將赴火而死，既而不能引決，尋為王師所擒，舉族遷於京師。

translations.literal: On the fifth day of the second month of the fourth year the imperial army pressed Guangzhou; Chang burned all the treasury stores and was about to throw himself into the fire and die, yet could not bring himself to it, and was soon seized by the imperial army; the whole clan was moved to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day of the second month of the fourth year the imperial army pressed Guangzhou. Chang burned the treasury and meant to throw himself into the fire, yet could not bring himself to it. He was soon seized and the whole clan was moved to the capital.

sentences.zh: 皇上赦而不誅，仍賜爵為恩赦侯，其後事具皇家日曆。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven pardoned him without execution and still granted the title Marquis of Enshi; his later affairs are recorded in the imperial calendar.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor pardoned him without execution and granted the title Marquis of Enshi. His later affairs are recorded in the imperial calendar.

sentences.zh: 陟始自梁貞明三年僭號，歷三世四主，至皇朝開寶四年，凡五十五年而亡。

translations.literal: From the time Zhi first styled himself in the third year of Zhenming of Liang through three generations and four rulers to the fourth year of Kaibao of the dynasty, in all fifty-five years and then extinction.
translations.idiomatic: From the time Zhi first styled himself in the third year of Zhenming of Liang through three generations and four rulers to the fourth year of Kaibao of our dynasty, fifty-five years passed and the state perished.

sentences.zh: 劉崇，太原人，漢高祖之從弟也。

translations.literal: Liu Chong was a man of Taiyuan, a younger cousin of the Han founder Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chong was a man of Taiyuan, a younger cousin of Han founder Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 少無賴，好陸博意錢之戲，弱冠隸河東軍。

translations.literal: From youth he was a ruffian, fond of gambling games with loaded dice; at weak cap he entered the Hedong army.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was a ruffian, fond of gambling with loaded dice. At weak cap he entered the Hedong army.

sentences.zh: 唐長興中，遷虢州軍校。

translations.literal: In the Changxing era of Tang he was promoted to guard officer of Guo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Changxing era of Tang he was promoted to guard officer of Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 漢祖鎮並、汾，奏為河東步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: When the Han founder held Bing and Fen he memorialized for him as commander of the Hedong foot army.
translations.idiomatic: When Han founder Gaozu held Bing and Fen he memorialized for Chong as commander of the Hedong foot army.

sentences.zh: 逾年，授麟州刺史，復為河東馬步軍都指揮使兼三城巡檢使，遙領泗州防禦使。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was appointed prefect of Lin, again made commander of the Hedong horse and foot army and concurrently inspector of the three cities, and remotely held the post of defender of Si Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he was appointed prefect of Lin, again made commander of the Hedong horse and foot army and concurrently inspector of the three cities, and remotely held defender of Si Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 漢祖起義於河東，以崇為特進、檢校太尉、行太原尹。

translations.literal: When the Han founder raised righteousness in Hedong, Chong was made Special Advancement, acting Grand Guardian, and acting Taiyuan Director.
translations.idiomatic: When Han founder raised righteousness in Hedong, Chong was made Special Advancement, acting Grand Guardian, and acting Taiyuan Director.

sentences.zh: 是歲五月，漢祖南行，以崇為北京留守，尋加同平章事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of that year the Han founder marched south; Chong was made northern capital regent, and soon added Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of that year Han founder marched south. Chong was made northern capital regent and soon added Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 隱帝嗣位，加檢校太師、兼侍中。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yin succeeded the throne he was further made acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yin succeeded he was further made acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 乾祐二年九月，加兼中書令。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Qianyou he was further made concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of Qianyou he was further made concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時漢隱帝以幼年在位，政在大臣，崇亦招募亡命，繕完兵甲，為自全之計，朝廷命令，多不稟行，征斂一方，略無虛日，人甚苦之。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Yin of Han was young on the throne and government lay with great ministers; Chong also recruited fugitives and repaired armor and weapons as a plan for self-preservation; of court commands many were not obeyed, and levies in his region scarcely had a day free — the people suffered greatly.
translations.idiomatic: At that time young Emperor Yin held the throne and great ministers held power. Chong recruited fugitives, repaired arms, and planned for self-preservation. Many court commands he ignored, and levies in his region scarcely paused a day — the people suffered greatly.

sentences.zh: 三年十一月，隱帝遇害，朝廷議立崇之子徐州節度使赟為主，會周太祖為軍眾所推，降封赟為湘陰公。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year Emperor Yin was murdered; the court deliberated making Chong's son Yun, military governor of Xuzhou, ruler; when Zhou Taizu was pushed by the army Yun was demoted to Duke of Xiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the third year Emperor Yin was murdered. The court deliberated making Chong's son Yun, military governor of Xuzhou, ruler. When Zhou Taizu was pushed by the army Yun was demoted to Duke of Xiangyin.

sentences.zh: 崇乃遣牙將李筠奉書求赟歸藩，會赟已死，唯以優辭答之。

translations.literal: Chong then sent guard officer Li Yun with a letter begging that Yun return to his fief; when Yun had already died he answered only with gracious words.
translations.idiomatic: Chong then sent guard officer Li Yun with a letter begging Yun's return to his fief. When Yun had already died he answered only with gracious words.

sentences.zh: 周廣順元年正月，崇僭號於河東，稱漢，改名旻，仍以乾祐為年號。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Guangshun of Zhou Chong styled himself in Hedong, calling his state Han, changed his name to Min, and still used Qianyou as reign title.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Guangshun of Zhou Chong styled himself in Hedong, called his state Han, changed his name to Min, and still used Qianyou as reign title.

sentences.zh: 署其子承鈞為侍衛親軍都指揮使、太原尹，以判官鄭拱、趙華為宰相，副使李瑰、代州刺史張暉為腹心，尋遣承鈞率兵攻晉、隰二州，不克而退。

translations.literal: He appointed his son Chengjun commander of the personal guard and Taiyuan Director, made judges Zheng Gong and Zhao Hua grand councilors, vice commissioners Li Gui and Dai Prefecture commissioner Zhang Hui his inner circle, and soon sent Chengjun to lead troops against Jin and Xi prefectures but could not take them and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed his son Chengjun commander of the personal guard and Taiyuan Director, made judges Zheng Gong and Zhao Hua grand councilors, and vice commissioners Li Gui and Dai commissioner Zhang Hui his inner circle. He soon sent Chengjun against Jin and Xi but could not take them and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 九月，崇自領兵由陰地關寇晉州，乞師於契丹，契丹以五千騎助之，合兵以攻平陽，又分兵寇昭義。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Chong personally led troops through Yindi Pass to raid Jin Prefecture, begged troops from the Khitan, and the Khitan aided him with five thousand horse; they joined forces to attack Pingyang and also divided troops to raid Zhaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Chong personally led troops through Yindi Pass to raid Jin Prefecture, begged troops from the Khitan, and received five thousand horse. They joined to attack Pingyang and divided troops to raid Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 周太祖遣樞密使王峻等率大軍以援晉、絳，崇聞周師至，遂焚營而遁。

translations.literal: Zhou Taizu sent Palace Director Wang Jun and others with a great army to relieve Jin and Jiang; when Chong heard Zhou troops had come he burned his camp and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Taizu sent Palace Director Wang Jun and others with a great army to relieve Jin and Jiang. When Chong heard Zhou troops had come he burned his camp and fled.

sentences.zh: 是歲，晉、絳大雪，崇駐軍六十餘日，邊民走險自固，兵無所掠，士有饑色，比至太原，十亡三四。

translations.literal: That year Jin and Jiang had heavy snow; Chong halted his army more than sixty days; border people fled to rugged places to hold themselves secure and the troops had nothing to plunder; the soldiers showed hunger; by the time they reached Taiyuan three or four in ten had perished.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jin and Jiang had heavy snow. Chong halted more than sixty days while border people fled to rugged places and troops had nothing to plunder. The soldiers showed hunger, and by Taiyuan three or four in ten had perished.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，崇遣兵三千餘眾寇府州，為折德扆所破，其所部岢嵐軍為德扆所取。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year Chong sent more than three thousand troops to raid Fu Prefecture and was defeated by Zhe Dewei; his subordinate Kelan army was taken by Dewei.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year Chong sent more than three thousand troops to raid Fu Prefecture and was defeated by Zhe Dewei, who also took his Kelan army.

sentences.zh: 崇自僭稱之後，以重幣求援於契丹，仍稱侄以事之，契丹偽冊為英武皇帝。

translations.literal: After he styled himself Chong used heavy gifts to seek aid from the Khitan and still called himself nephew in serving them; the Khitan falsely invested him as Martial and Martial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: After he styled himself Chong used heavy gifts to seek Khitan aid and called himself nephew in serving them. The Khitan falsely invested him as Martial and Martial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 及周世宗嗣位，崇復乞師於契丹，以圖入寇，契丹遣將楊袞合勢大舉，來迫潞州。

translations.literal: When Zhou Shizong succeeded the throne Chong again begged troops from the Khitan to plan invasion; the Khitan sent commander Yang Gun in combined force on a great scale to press Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou Shizong succeeded Chong again begged Khitan troops to plan invasion. The Khitan sent commander Yang Gun in great combined force against Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 顯德元年三月，周世宗親征，與崇戰於高平，大敗之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Xiande Zhou Shizong campaigned in person and fought Chong at Gaoping, routing him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Xiande Zhou Shizong campaigned in person and routed Chong greatly at Gaoping.

sentences.zh: 崇與親騎十數人逾山而遁，中夜迷懵，不知所適，劫村民使為鄉導，誤趨晉州路，行百餘里方覺。

translations.literal: Chong with a dozen or so of his personal horse fled over the mountains; in the middle of the night, dazed, he knew not where he was, seized villagers to serve as guides, mistakenly hurried along the Jin Prefecture road, and only after more than a hundred li realized it.
translations.idiomatic: Chong fled over the mountains with a dozen personal horse. In the middle of the night, dazed, he knew not where he was, seized villagers as guides, mistakenly took the Jin Prefecture road, and only after more than a hundred li realized it.

sentences.zh: 崇怒，殺鄉導者，得他路而去，乃易名號，被毛褐、張樺笠而行。

translations.literal: Chong in anger killed the guides, took another road and left, then changed his name, wore coarse wool and a birch-bark hat, and went on.
translations.idiomatic: Chong in anger killed the guides, took another road, changed his name, wore coarse wool and a birch-bark hat, and went on.

sentences.zh: 至沁州，與從者三五騎止於郊舍，寒餒尤甚，潛令告偽刺史李廷誨，廷誨饋盤餐、解衣裘而與之。

translations.literal: Reaching Qin Prefecture he halted with three or five horsemen at a suburban lodge, suffering extreme cold and hunger; he secretly sent word to the false prefect Li Tinghui, and Tinghui gave him a meal and lent him a fur coat.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Qin Prefecture he halted with three or five horsemen at a suburban lodge in extreme cold and hunger. He secretly sent word to false prefect Li Tinghui, who gave him a meal and lent a fur coat.

sentences.zh: 每至屬邑，縣吏奉食，匕箸未舉，聞周師至，即蒼黃而去。

translations.literal: Whenever he reached a subordinate district the district clerks offered food; before he had raised chopsticks and spoon he heard Zhou troops had come and fled in panic.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he reached a subordinate district clerks offered food. Before he raised chopsticks he heard Zhou troops had come and fled in panic.

sentences.zh: 崇年老力憊，伏於馬上，日夜奔竄，僅能支持。

translations.literal: Chong, old and exhausted in strength, lay prostrate on his horse, fleeing day and night, barely able to hold on.
translations.idiomatic: Chong, old and exhausted, lay prostrate on his horse, fleeing day and night, barely able to hold on.

sentences.zh: 距太原一舍，其子承鈞夜以兵百人迎之而入。

translations.literal: One stage from Taiyuan his son Chengjun at night met him with a hundred troops and brought him in.
translations.idiomatic: One stage from Taiyuan his son Chengjun met him at night with a hundred troops and brought him in.

sentences.zh: 及周師臨城下，崇氣懾，自固閉壘不出。

translations.literal: When Zhou troops came beneath the walls Chong's spirit was cowed and he held himself behind closed ramparts without sallying.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou troops came beneath the walls Chong's spirit was cowed and he held behind closed ramparts without sallying.

sentences.zh: 月餘，世宗乃旋軍。

translations.literal: After more than a month Shizong then turned the army back.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month Shizong turned the army back.

sentences.zh: 顯德二年十一月，崇以病死，其子承鈞襲偽位。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of Xiande Chong died of illness and his son Chengjun seized the false throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the second year of Xiande Chong died of illness and his son Chengjun seized the false throne.

sentences.zh: 鈞之事跡具皇家日曆。

translations.literal: Chengjun's deeds are recorded in the imperial calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Chengjun's deeds are recorded in the imperial calendar.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：守光逆天反道，從古所無，迨至臨刑，尚求免死，非唯惡之極也，抑亦愚之甚也。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Shouguang defied Heaven and reversed the Way — from antiquity there has been none like him; when he came to execution he still begged to escape death — not only is wickedness at its extreme, stupidity is also at its height.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: Shouguang defied Heaven and reversed the Way — from antiquity there has been none like him. When he came to execution he still begged to escape death. This is wickedness at its extreme and stupidity at its height.

sentences.zh: 劉晟據南極以稱雄，屬中原之多事，洎乎奕世，遇我昌朝，力憊而亡，不泯其嗣，亦其幸也。

translations.literal: Liu Sheng held the southern pole to proclaim supremacy while the central plains were in many troubles; through generations until our flourishing dynasty, his strength spent he perished yet his line was not extinguished — this too was his fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Sheng held the far south to proclaim supremacy while the central plains were in turmoil. Through generations until our flourishing dynasty his strength was spent and he perished, yet his line was not extinguished — this too was fortune.

sentences.zh: 劉崇以亡國之餘，竊偽王之號，多見其不知量也。

translations.literal: Liu Chong, remnant of a perished state, stole the title of false king — one often sees that he did not know his measure.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chong, remnant of a perished state, stole the title of false king — one often sees he did not know his measure.

sentences.zh: 今元惡雖斃，遣孽尚存，勢蹙民殘，不亡何待！

translations.literal: Now though the chief villain is dead, surviving evil remains; his power cramped and his people ruined — if he does not perish, what is he waiting for!
translations.idiomatic: Now though the chief villain is dead, surviving evil remains. His power is cramped and his people ruined — if he does not perish, what is he waiting for!
